RelpermResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a relperm export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

KEYWORD.description: The Eclipse saturation function keyword this row is derived from. Required.
KEYWORD.title: Keyword

KRG.description: The gas relative permeability this row represents. Optional.
KRG.title: Krg

KROG.description: The oil-gas relative permeability this row represents. Optional.
KROG.title: Krog

KROW.description: The oil-water relative permeability this row represents. Optional.
KROW.title: Krow

KRW.description: The water relative permeability this row represents. Optional.
KRW.title: Krw

PCOG.description: The oil-gas capillary pressure this row represents. Optional.
PCOG.title: Pcog

PCOW.description: The oil-water capillary pressure this row represents. Optional.
PCOW.title: Pcow

SATNUM.description: Index column. The saturation function region this row represents. Required.
SATNUM.title: Satnum

SG.description: The gas saturation this row represents. Optional.
SG.title: Sg

SW.description: The water saturation this row represents. Optional.
SW.title: Sw

RelpermResultRow.title: RelpermResultRow

description: Represents the resultant relperm parquet file as a list of rows.
title: RelpermResult
